paragraphs: Rav Rehumi spoke to Abaye: Pesahim 39a. Ben Rehumi asked Abaye: Nazir 13a. He sat before Ravina and spoke in Rav Huna bar Tahlifa's name: Zevahim 77a. Rav Rehumi taught it thus: Rav Yehudah son of Rav Shmuel—in Asheri, bar Sheilat—in Rav's name: Eruvin 14, end of b. ‘What are pithhei shammai?’ R' Rehumi and Rav Yosef disagree; one says, etc., the other says, etc.: Eruvin 11a. Menahot 33b: ‘What are pithhei shammai?’ Rav Rehumi and Abba Yosi disagree; one says, etc. Heilprin proposes Yosef. Rif, Halakhot Ketanot, Laws of Mezuzah, reads Rav Yosef. Heilprin places Rav Rehumi’s death at Mahoza on the eve of Yom Kippur and describes him as attending Rava. Rav Rehumi used to return home every eve of Yom Kippur. One day his study detained him. His wife waited, saying, ‘Now he will come.’ He did not come. She was distressed, and a tear fell from her eye. The step beneath him collapsed and he died. The account in Ketubbot 62b specifies a roof and describes attendance before Rava as his regular practice. He challenged Ravina: Hullin 89, end of a. ‘I saw Ravina’: Yoma 78a. See Part I, year 4203, where Heilprin records that a Rav Rehumi headed the academy at Pumbedita for thirteen years. [Glosses: Rehumi. Menahot 33b: Rav Rehumi and Abba Yosi. The new Shas [שס״ח; specific edition uncollated] has Rabbah Rehumi, a scribal error. That matter in Eruvin 11a has Rav Rehumi and Rav Yosef; this needs examination.]
